symbolDescription: Imperative viewer API, available through ref and passed to renderToolbar. Values are a snapshot of the render that produced the object.

optionDescriptions.page: Current 1-based page, clamped to the document.
optionDescriptions.download: Save the loaded document (no second request).
optionDescriptions.getDocument: The loaded PDF.js document, for advanced use. Do not destroy it.
optionDescriptions.reload: Load the source again, e.g. after an error.
optionDescriptions.setScale: Set the scale, clamped to [minScale, maxScale].
optionDescriptions.fullscreen: Whether the viewer is in fullscreen.
